findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:30 reports 762 Chinese-bearing cli-engine.ts lines, but docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:167 defines the current table as a catalog and defers every-line coverage to a later manifest; docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:90 and :373 also state that every Chinese-bearing line still needs manifest mapping. The committed document contains 173 T### catalog rows, so it is a representative catalog plus an execution plan, not the complete every-Chinese-translation result set requested for human audit. This blocks the requested deliverable until the document includes an auditable line-level translation result/mapping for all 762 Chinese-bearing lines or clearly obtains user acceptance for a representative catalog instead.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md Complete Line-Level Translation Manifest. The manifest has 762 rows matching the 762 Chinese-bearing packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts lines, with proposedEnglish populated for each row and no Chinese or fallback placeholders in proposedEnglish.

findings.desc: Translation review packet is incomplete for approval. The document reports 762 Chinese-bearing cli-engine.ts lines and says implementation must not start until every line maps to an approved catalog row (docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:30, :89-91), but the Translation Review Table is only 173 rows and ends at T173 (same doc :167-169, :345). It omits later public CLI command descriptions/schema descriptions that still expose Chinese text, including draft_check_set/draft_issue_resolve (packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:383, :392), delivery_waiver_add/scope_question_resolve (packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1671, :1710), and dispatch/background_set (packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1733, :1742). Since this story is meant to provide Chinese-source-to-English translation material for reviewer approval, later implementation would still need to invent unreviewed translations.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by adding the missing later CLI public surfaces to the Complete Line-Level Translation Manifest, including draft_check_set, draft_issue_resolve, delivery_waiver_add, scope_question_resolve, dispatch, background_set, help output, and INIT_CHECK hints. Mechanical validation confirms 762 source lines map to 762 manifest rows.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md line 75-83 specifies column order as line|surface|chineseSource|translationId|proposedEnglish|reviewStatus, but the actual TSV block at line 359 uses translationId|sourceLine|surface|chineseSource|proposedEnglish|reviewStatus — translationId and line swap positions, and the column is renamed from `line` to `sourceLine`. An implementer running the spec-prescribed extract script would need to reconcile which column order is authoritative before writing or validating the manifest.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 2c07f23e7 (spec-table order/sourceLine rename, cli-output enum, Argument-validation term).

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md line 79 defines valid `surface` enum values as schema|command-description|help|error|hint|comment|other, but the TSV manifest (starting at line 359) uses `cli-output` as a surface value (28 rows: M671-M762 area) which is not in the defined enum. The values `error` and `hint` appear only in the T-table (not in the TSV). An implementer writing the extract script or validating manifest rows would encounter surface values not matching the documented enum.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 2c07f23e7 (spec-table order/sourceLine rename, cli-output enum, Argument-validation term).

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md has an internal translation inconsistency for the Chinese phrase for parameter validation failure: the Translation Review Table (T128, line 304) proposes "Parameter validation failed" while the line-level manifest rows M679/M680 (lines 1038-1039) for the same phrase propose "Argument validation failed". The T-table is described as the reusable catalog for common phrases and the manifest is the authoritative per-line packet; they should agree on the English rendering of the same term.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 2c07f23e7 (spec-table order/sourceLine rename, cli-output enum, Argument-validation term).
